title: Cost of the LCFs' meaning: the taught configurations that converged, on training seeds 2 to 4
description: The recipe of exp-lcf-cost-teacher-317 (the actor, and for the free arm the encoder, cloned for 10,000 updates from BBRv3's logged steps, then 20,000 RL updates on all the data with fresh critics) on training seeds 2, 3 and 4, for every configuration whose training converged on both seeds 0 and 1: paper (neto1 v1's seven values) with the clone alone, CQL weight 0.01, 0.1 or 1, or TD3+BC; freefix (seven free latents, the encoder held fixed after the clone) with the clone alone, CQL 0.01 or TD3+BC. freefix at CQL 0.1 (seed 0: critic loss 383,265, every action at -1) and CQL 1 (seed 0: Q 104 against the paper arm's 19) and every freeslow configuration (the encoder learning at 1e-5: critic losses up to 4e8) did not converge and are not trained again. Trained before the closed-loop choice so that seeds 2 to 4 of whichever configurations win are ready for the report run; policies lcft-ARM-RL-sSEED.
run: case "$ARM-$RL" in freefix-cql0.1|freefix-cql1) echo "diverged or drifted on seeds 0 and 1 (exp-lcf-cost-teacher-317): not a candidate" > "$OUT/skipped-$ARM-$RL-s$SEED.txt"; exit 0;; esac; N="$IN/n/$(cat "$IN/n/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; O="$OUT/lcft-$ARM-$RL-s$SEED"; T="$O/teacher"; [ "$RL" = none ] && T="$O"; mkdir -p "$T"; FREE='{}'; [ "$ARM" != paper ] && FREE='{"inputs": "raw", "encoder": "free"}'; jq -n --arg d "$IN/d" --arg n "$N" --argjson seed "$SEED" --argjson free "$FREE" '{data: [$d], split_by: "link", seed: $seed, net1_from: $n, controllers: ["bbr3"], net2: ({algo: "bc", action: "multiplier", reward: "sage", reward_alignment: "same", action_max: 1.0, action_decimals: 3, steps: 10000} + $free)}' > "$T/train.json"; uv run expliccit train run "$T/train.json" "$T"; rm -f "$T/net1.pt"; if [ "$RL" != none ]; then case "$RL" in cql*) R="{\"algo\": \"expliccit-v1\", \"cql_alpha\": ${RL#cql}}";; td3bc) R='{"algo": "td3bc", "alpha": 2.5}';; esac; E='{}'; [ "$ARM" = freefix ] && E='{"encoder_lr": 0}'; [ "$ARM" = freeslow ] && E='{"encoder_lr": 1e-5}'; jq -n --arg d "$IN/d" --arg n "$N" --arg t "$T/net2.pt" --argjson seed "$SEED" --argjson free "$FREE" --argjson rl "$R" --argjson enc "$E" '{data: [$d], split_by: "link", seed: $seed, net1_from: $n, net2_from: $t, net2: ({action: "multiplier", reward: "sage", reward_alignment: "same", action_max: 1.0, action_decimals: 3, steps: 20000} + $rl + $free + $enc)}' > "$O/train.json"; uv run expliccit train run "$O/train.json" "$O"; rm -f "$O/net1.pt"; fi
collect: { echo "| policy | stage | transitions | validation BC error | seconds | final diagnostics |"; echo "|---|---|---|---|---|---|"; for r in "$OUT"/lcft-*/report.json "$OUT"/lcft-*/teacher/report.json; do [ -f "$r" ] || continue; d=$(dirname "$r"); n=$(basename "$d"); s=rl; [ "$n" = teacher ] && { n=$(basename "$(dirname "$d")"); s=teacher; }; case "$n" in *-none-*) s=teacher;; esac; echo "| $n | $s | $(jq -r '[.net2.transitions, .net2.val_bc_mse, (.net2.seconds | floor), (.net2.final | to_entries | map("\(.key) \(.value | tostring | .[0:7])") | join(", "))] | join(" | ")' "$r") |"; done; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
